examples.zh: 夕阳西下时，疲惫的通勤者踏上了回家的路途。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homeward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: drive away by hitting with one's ball,

examples.en: She managed to croquet her opponent's ball straight into the rough grass.
examples.zh: 她成功贴击对手的球，将其直接击入深草丛中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 croquet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of winds) coming from the sea toward the land

examples.en: Small inshore boats returned to the harbor before the storm broke.
examples.zh: 小型近海渔船在暴风雨来临前回到了港口。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inshore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 等等, 额外的人(或物)
lemmas.def_en: additional unspecified odds and ends; more of the same

examples.en: The drawer was cluttered with old pens, clips, notes, and etceteras.
examples.zh: 抽屉里塞满了旧笔、回形针、便签以及诸如此类的杂物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 etcetera 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a square position

examples.en: The committee stood foursquare behind the director's bold new proposals.
examples.zh: 委员会坚定而坚定不移地支持总监大胆的新提议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foursquare 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of racket strokes) made with palm facing direction of stroke

examples.en: He won the final match with a powerful forehand drive down the line.
examples.zh: 他凭借一记强劲的正手沿直线抽球赢得了决赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forehand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 植绒的, 有簇饰的, 成簇状的
lemmas.def_en: (of plants) growing in small dense clumps or tufts

examples.en: The living room featured a classic sofa with elegant tufted upholstery.
examples.zh: 客厅里摆放着一张配有优雅簇绒软垫的经典沙发。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tufted 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stopping place on a journey

examples.en: We booked a two-day stopover in Tokyo on our way to Sydney.
examples.zh: 我们在飞往悉尼的途中预订了在东京停留两天的行程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stopover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 事与愿违的, 麻烦的, 困难的, 不幸的
lemmas.def_en: not in keeping with accepted standards of what is right or proper in polite society

examples.en: The security team ensured that no untoward incident disrupted the summit.
examples.zh: 安保团队确保了没有任何意外麻烦破坏峰会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 untoward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an antique record player; the sound of the vibrating needle is amplified acoustically

examples.en: An antique gramophone was playing scratchy jazz records in the corner.
examples.zh: 角落里的一台古董留声机正播放着带有沙沙杂音的爵士唱片。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gramophone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 在最上面, 在最高处
lemmas.def_en: in or into the most prominent position, as in the mind

examples.en: Safety should always be kept uppermost in mind while operating machinery.
examples.zh: 在操作机械时，安全永远应该放在首要位置。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 uppermost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various fine-grained silty soils that become waxy and very sticky mud when saturated with water

examples.en: She served a steaming bowl of spicy seafood gumbo with white rice.
examples.zh: 她端上了一碗热气腾腾的香辣海鲜浓汤杂烩配白饭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gumbo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 外行的, 缺少经验的
lemmas.def_en: not initiated; deficient in relevant experience

examples.en: To the uninitiated, the complex software interface can seem utterly bewildering.
examples.zh: 对于外行来说，这个复杂的软件界面可能显得完全令人困惑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 uninitiated 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 柠檬的, 取自柠檬的
lemmas.def_en: of or related to citric acid

examples.en: Lemons and limes contain high levels of natural citric acid.
examples.zh: 柠檬和青柠含有大量的天然柠檬酸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 citric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 翠绿的, 青翠的, 无经验的, 不老练的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by abundance of verdure

examples.en: The train journey offered breathtaking views of lush, verdant rolling hills.
examples.zh: 这段火车之旅让人饱览了郁郁葱葱的青翠山丘美景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 verdant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不适当, 愚笨, 愚昧言行
lemmas.def_en: unskillfulness resulting from a lack of training

examples.en: The project failed primarily due to the administrative team's gross ineptitude.
examples.zh: 该项目的失败主要是由于管理团队极其无能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ineptitude 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an official report (usually sent in haste)

examples.en: The leaders issued a joint communique outlining their new economic agreements.
examples.zh: 各国领导人发表联合公报，概述了他们达成的新经济协议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 communique 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: immense East Indian fruit resembling breadfruit; it contains an edible pulp and nutritious seeds that are commonly roasted

examples.en: A ripe jak fruit fell from the tall tree onto the path.
examples.zh: 一个成熟的木菠萝从高树上掉落到了小路上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of the salts of hydrobromic acid; formerly used as a sedative but now generally replaced by safer drugs

examples.en: He offered only an empty bromide instead of practical help or sympathy.
examples.zh: 他只说了一句空洞陈腐的话，并未提供实际的帮助或同情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bromide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 羊毛的, 羊毛制的, 毛织的
lemmas.def_en: of or related to or made of wool

examples.en: She wrapped a thick woolen scarf tightly around her neck for warmth.
examples.zh: 她把一条厚羊毛围巾紧紧围在脖子上取暖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 woolen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 最外面的, 最远离中心的
lemmas.def_en: situated at the farthest possible point from a center

examples.en: Neptune is the outermost recognized planet in our solar system.
examples.zh: 海王星是我们太阳系中已知最外侧的行星。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outermost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: some point in the air; above ground level

examples.en: The acrobats successfully performed a daring midair catch during the show.
examples.zh: 杂技演员在演出中成功完成了一次大胆的半空接人动作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 midair 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a noblewoman ranking below a duchess and above a countess

examples.en: The wealthy marquise hosted an extravagant banquet at her French countryside estate.
examples.zh: 富有的侯爵夫人在她位于法国乡村的庄园举办了奢华的宴会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marquise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 值班名册, 值班, 花名册
lemmas.def_en: (Roman Catholic Church) the supreme ecclesiastical tribunal for cases appealed to the Holy See from diocesan courts

examples.en: The manager posted the updated duty rota on the staff notice board.
examples.zh: 经理把更新后的值班名册张贴在员工公告栏上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rota 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人快乐的, 美味的, 使人愉快的
lemmas.def_en: extremely pleasing to the sense of taste

examples.en: The local bakery is famous for its delectable assortment of fresh pastries.
examples.zh: 这家当地的面包店以其各种美味的新鲜糕点而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 delectable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: meat that has been barbecued or grilled in a highly seasoned sauce

examples.en: We spent Sunday afternoon enjoying a lively backyard barbeque with our neighbors.
examples.zh: 我们周日下午和邻居们在后院享受了一场热闹的烧烤野餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barbeque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: absent without leave 擅离职守的
lemmas.def_en: absent without permission

examples.en: The soldier went AWOL and faced severe disciplinary action upon his capture.
examples.zh: 那名士兵擅离职守，被捕后受到了严厉的纪律处分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 awol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 基本态度, 敌意, 意向
lemmas.def_en: a feeling of ill will arousing active hostility

examples.en: Despite their political differences, he held no personal animus toward his opponent.
examples.zh: 尽管政治立场不同，但他对对手并没有个人敌意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 animus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cup of tea

examples.en: Sit down and let me brew you a hot cuppa to relax.
examples.zh: 坐下来，让我给你泡一杯热茶放松一下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuppa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 王权, 王位标识, 标记, 徽章
lemmas.def_en: paraphernalia indicative of royalty (or other high office)

examples.en: The monarch appeared in full royal regalia during the formal state ceremony.
examples.zh: 君主在正式的国事典礼上佩戴着全套王室礼器徽章亮相。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 regalia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 领班神父, (英国国教会)会吏总
lemmas.def_en: (Anglican Church) an ecclesiastical dignitary usually ranking just below a bishop

examples.en: The venerable archdeacon visited the historic parish to conduct the Sunday service.
examples.zh: 德高望重的会吏总访问了这座历史悠久的教区，主持了周日礼拜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 archdeacon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of intense dislike

examples.en: He made no attempt to conceal his deep antipathy toward corrupt politicians.
examples.zh: 他毫不掩饰自己对腐败政客的极度反感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antipathy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the shore of a lake

examples.en: They enjoyed a peaceful morning walk along the scenic, misty lakeshore.
examples.zh: 他们在风景优美、薄雾笼罩的湖岸边享受了宁静的晨练散步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lakeshore 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: slice of sweet raised bread baked again until it is brown and hard and crisp

examples.en: The mother gave the teething toddler a hard rusk to gnaw on.
examples.zh: 母亲给了正在出牙的蹒跚学步的幼童一块硬面包干啃咬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rusk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or attended by putrefaction

examples.en: A putrid smell arose from the garbage heap left rotting in the heat.
examples.zh: 在酷热中腐烂的垃圾堆散发出一股腐臭的气味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 putrid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal lateral curve to the vertebral column

examples.en: The doctor detected mild scoliosis during the routine annual physical examination.
examples.zh: 医生在例行的年度体检中发现了他有轻度脊柱侧凸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scoliosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 梦魇似的, 可怕的, 经常使人恐惧的
lemmas.def_en: extremely alarming

examples.en: Commuters faced a nightmarish journey home after the severe storm crippled the transit system.
examples.zh: 暴风雨瘫痪了交通系统后，通勤者经历了一场噩梦般的回家旅程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightmarish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who receives support and protection from an influential patron who furthers the protege's career

examples.en: The renowned architect proudly introduced his young protege at the international design summit.
examples.zh: 这位著名建筑师在国际设计峰会上自豪地介绍了他的年轻门徒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 protege 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 回降, 卷回, 推回去
lemmas.def_en: the act of forcing the enemy to withdraw

examples.en: Environmental groups protested the government's sudden rollback of strict emission regulations.
examples.zh: 环保组织抗议政府突然倒退并放宽严格的排放法规。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rollback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: predicts the weather

examples.en: The television weatherman warned residents to prepare for heavy snowfall this weekend.
examples.zh: 电视气象预报员警告居民为本周末的暴雪做好准备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 weatherman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: superiority in power or influence

examples.en: The preponderance of scientific evidence clearly supports the theory of human-driven climate change.
examples.zh: 大多数科学证据显然都支持人类活动导致气候变化的理论。

lemmas.def_zh: 占优势的, 多数的, 主要的, 突出的
lemmas.def_en: having superior power and influence

examples.en: Economic factors played a preponderant role in the government's final decision.
examples.zh: 经济因素在政府的最终决策中起到了主要作用。

lemmas.def_en: much greater in number or influence

examples.en: the patients are predominantly indigenous

family_guide.root_logic: 以 preponderance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a garden plant of the genus Antirrhinum having showy white or yellow or crimson flowers resembling the face of a dragon

examples.en: She planted colorful snapdragons along the garden pathway to attract bees and butterflies.
examples.zh: 她在花园小径旁种下了五彩斑斓的金鱼草，以吸引蜜蜂和蝴蝶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snapdragon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 包含两个名词(或名称的), 二项式的, 双名的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or consisting of two terms

examples.en: In biology class, students learned how to write the binomial name of every species.
examples.zh: 在生物课上，学生们学习了如何书写每个物种的双名法学名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 binomial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the sport of shooting at clay pigeons that are hurled upward in such a way as to simulate the flight of a bird

examples.en: He spends his Saturday mornings at the local shooting club practicing skeet.
examples.zh: 他周六早晨都在当地的射击俱乐部练习双向飞碟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skeet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: marked by excessive enthusiasm for and intense devotion to a cause or idea

examples.en: An overzealous security guard refused to let anyone enter without showing their original receipt.
examples.zh: 一名过分热心的保安拒绝让任何未出示原始收据的人进入。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overzealous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 感染性蛋白质, 普列昂; 锯鹱
lemmas.def_en: (microbiology) an infectious protein particle similar to a virus but lacking nucleic acid; thought to be the agent responsible for scrapie and other degenerative diseases of the nervous system

examples.en: Mad cow disease is caused by an abnormal prion that damages brain tissue.
examples.zh: 疯牛病是由一种破坏脑组织的异常朊病毒引起的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a metric unit of length equal to one millionth of a meter

examples.en: The machinist used a digital micrometer to measure the precise thickness of the metal.
examples.zh: 机械师使用数显测微计精确测量了金属的厚度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 micrometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sailboat with two parallel hulls held together by single deck

examples.en: They rented a sleek catamaran to sail smoothly between the tropical Caribbean islands.
examples.zh: 他们租了一艘漂亮的双体船，在热带加勒比群岛之间平稳航行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 catamaran 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a form of social system in which power goes to those with superior intellects

examples.en: The company claims to be a true meritocracy where talent and effort determine promotions.
examples.zh: 该公司声称是真正的精英管理体制，才能和努力决定晋升。

lemmas.def_zh: 精英管理的；贤能统治的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or characteristic of a meritocracy

examples.en: meritocratic society

family_guide.root_logic: 以 meritocracy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 枝条构架, 编条, 枝条, 板条, 肉垂, 鱼须
lemmas.def_en: a fleshy wrinkled and often brightly colored fold of skin hanging from the neck or throat of certain birds (chickens and turkeys) or lizards

examples.en: Villagers used mud and wattle to build traditional huts that withstood the harsh climate.
examples.zh: 村民们用泥土和编条搭建经得起恶劣气候考验的传统茅屋。

lemmas.def_en: build of or with wattle

examples.en: Villagers used mud and wattle to build traditional huts that withstood the harsh climate.
examples.zh: 村民们用泥土和编条搭建经得起恶劣气候考验的传统茅屋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wattle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hairlike projection from the surface of a cell; provides locomotion in free-swimming unicellular organisms

examples.en: Under the microscope, each tiny cilium beat rhythmically to move fluid along the surface.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，每根微小的纤毛都有节奏地摆动以输送表面的液体。

lemmas.def_zh: 眼睫毛的, 纤毛的, 纤毛状的
lemmas.def_en: relating to the ciliary body and associated structures of the eye

examples.en: The ciliary muscle helps the eye focus on nearby objects by changing lens shape.
examples.zh: 睫状肌通过改变晶状体形状帮助眼睛聚焦于近处物体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cilium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 前兆, 预示, 异常之物
lemmas.def_en: a sign of something about to happen

examples.en: Ancient sailors considered a blood-red sky in the morning a dire portent of danger.
examples.zh: 古代水手将清晨血红色的天空视为危险的可怕预兆。

lemmas.def_zh: 前兆的, 不吉的, 可惊的, 自大的
lemmas.def_en: of momentous or ominous significance; - Herman Melville

examples.en: such a portentous...monster raised all my curiosity
a prodigious vision

lemmas.def_zh: 不祥地；有预兆地；盛气凌人地, 自负地
lemmas.def_en: in a portentous manner

examples.en: portentously, the engines began to roll

lemmas.def_zh: 成为...的前兆, 预知, 给与...的警告
lemmas.def_en: indicate by signs

examples.en: The dark clouds gathering over the mountain portend a violent storm later tonight.
examples.zh: 山顶聚集的乌云预示着今晚晚些时候将有一场猛烈的暴风雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 portent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 金星, 启明星, 磷光体, 磷光剂, 磷光闪闪的东西
lemmas.def_en: a synthetic substance that is fluorescent or phosphorescent; used to coat the screens of cathode ray tubes

examples.en: The screen uses a special green phosphor that glows brightly in complete darkness.
examples.zh: 该屏幕使用了一种在完全黑暗中能发出明亮光芒的特殊绿色荧光粉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phosphor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tight-fitting garment of stretchy material that covers the body from the shoulders to the thighs (and may have long sleeves or legs reaching down to the ankles); worn by ballet dancers and acrobats for practice or performance

examples.en: The young gymnast adjusted her sparkly leotard just before stepping onto the mat.
examples.zh: 年轻的体操运动员在走上垫子前整理了她闪亮的紧身衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leotard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 部下, 下手, 下属
lemmas.def_en: an assistant subject to the authority or control of another

examples.en: The arrogant executive never bothered to learn the names of his office underlings.
examples.zh: 这位傲慢的高管从不屑于去记办公室下属的名字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cross in a pattern, often random

examples.en: Bright railway tracks crisscross the industrial landscape just outside the bustling city center.
examples.zh: 明亮的铁轨在繁忙的市中心外的工业区纵横交错。

lemmas.def_zh: adj. 纵横交错的；十字交叉纹的
lemmas.def_en: marked or covered with a pattern of crossing lines
lemmas.usage_note: 常用来修饰道路网、伤痕、电线或图案等呈交叉分布的形态。

examples.en: His face was crisscrossed with deep wrinkles from years of hard labor.
examples.zh: 多年的辛勤劳作使他的脸上布满了纵横交错的深邃皱纹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crisscross 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小酒馆老板, 酒店老板, 客栈老板, 征收员
lemmas.def_en: the keeper of a public house

examples.en: The friendly publican offered a warm greeting and poured fresh pints for the regulars.
examples.zh: 热情的酒馆老板向老主顾们致以温暖的问候，并倒上了新鲜的啤酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 publican 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who reads out broadcast news bulletin

examples.en: The calm newsreader announced the breaking story to millions of viewers watching nationwide.
examples.zh: 这位冷静的新闻主播向全国数百万收看电视的观众播报了突发新闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 newsreader 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 踝, 踝骨, 睑板, 跗骨
lemmas.def_en: the part of the foot of a vertebrate between the metatarsus and the leg; in human beings the bones of the ankle and heel collectively

examples.en: The doctor examined the hairline fracture in the patient's tarsus carefully.
examples.zh: 医生仔细检查了患者跗骨处的细微骨折。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or near the tarsus of the foot

examples.en: The doctor examined the tarsal bones after the athlete severely twisted his foot.
examples.zh: 运动员严重扭伤脚部后，医生仔细检查了他的跗骨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tarsus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 布卡（伊斯兰国家妇女穿的蒙面长袍）
lemmas.def_en: a loose garment (usually with veiled holes for the eyes) worn by Muslim women especially in India and Pakistan

examples.en: She wore a traditional blue burqa while walking through the bustling market.
examples.zh: 走在熙熙攘攘的集市上时，她穿了一件传统蓝色布卡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burqa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 带枪的歹徒, 被收买来行凶的人
lemmas.def_en: a professional killer who uses a gun

examples.en: The legendary gunslinger stepped into the dusty street for the final duel.
examples.zh: 这位传奇枪手走上尘土飞扬的街道，准备进行最后的决斗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunslinger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: easily irritated or annoyed

examples.en: Be patient with him today, as lack of sleep made him unusually techy.
examples.zh: 今天对他耐心点，睡眠不足让他变得异常暴躁。

lemmas.def_en: a technician who is highly proficient and enthusiastic about some technical field (especially computing)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 techy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: concerning or characterized by an appreciation of beauty or good taste

examples.en: The modern building combines practical function with a minimalist esthetic appeal.
examples.zh: 这座现代建筑兼具实用功能与极简主义审美魅力。

lemmas.def_en: (philosophy) a philosophical theory as to what is beautiful

examples.en: The modern building combines practical function with a minimalist esthetic appeal.
examples.zh: 这座现代建筑兼具实用功能与极简主义审美魅力。

lemmas.def_en: a worker skilled in giving beauty treatments (manicures and facials etc.)
in a tasteful way

examples.en: this building is aesthetically very pleasing

family_guide.root_logic: 以 esthetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 耻辱, 无耻行为, 不体面
lemmas.def_en: a state of dishonor

examples.en: The corrupt official faced the public ignominy of being led away in handcuffs.
examples.zh: 贪官面临着被戴上手铐带走的公开耻辱。

lemmas.def_zh: 可耻的, 不名誉的, 下流的
lemmas.def_en: (used of conduct or character) deserving or bringing disgrace or shame; - Rachel Carson

examples.en: Man...has written one of his blackest records as a destroyer on the oceanic islands
an ignominious retreat

lemmas.def_zh: 耻辱地, 屈辱地, 丢脸地
lemmas.def_en: in a dishonorable manner or to a dishonorable degree

examples.en: his grades were disgracefully low

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ignominy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 混入, 渗入, 掺杂；使混合
lemmas.def_en: combine into one

examples.en: Guests from different backgrounds began to intermingle and share stories at dinner.
examples.zh: 来自不同背景的客人在晚宴上开始相互交流并分享故事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intermingle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 上釉工人, 打光工人, 轧光机, 上光机
lemmas.def_en: someone who cuts flat glass to size

examples.en: The skilled glazer replaced the broken window pane within thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 技术熟练的装玻璃工人在三十分钟内换好了破碎的窗玻璃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glazer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: jewelry consisting of one of a pair of linked buttons used to fasten the cuffs of a shirt

examples.en: He fastened a silver cufflink to each sleeve before entering the ballroom.
examples.zh: 走进宴会厅前，他在两个袖口各扣上了一枚银质袖扣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cufflink 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (穆斯林女子在公众场合下穿的)蒙住全身(只留眼睛)的长袍
lemmas.def_en: a loose garment (usually with veiled holes for the eyes) worn by Muslim women especially in India and Pakistan

examples.en: Under the strict regime, women were required to wear a burka outdoors.
examples.zh: 在严苛的政权统治下，妇女在户外被要求穿戴蒙面长袍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burka 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an acrobatic feat in which the feet roll over the head (either forward or backward) and return

examples.en: The gymnast executed a flawless backward somersault and stuck the landing cleanly.
examples.zh: 体操运动员完成了一个完美的后空翻，并稳稳落地。

lemmas.def_en: do a somersault

examples.en: The gymnast executed a flawless backward somersault and stuck the landing cleanly.
examples.zh: 体操运动员完成了一个完美的后空翻，并稳稳落地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 somersault 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 预知的, 有先见之明的
lemmas.def_en: perceiving the significance of events before they occur; -R.H.Rovere

examples.en: Her prescient warning about the market crash saved the company millions.
examples.zh: 她对股市崩盘的先见之明为公司挽救了数百万资金。

lemmas.def_en: with foresight

examples.en: more presciently than they superiors, these workers grasped the economic situation

lemmas.def_en: the power to foresee the future

examples.en: Her prescience about market trends saved the firm millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 她对市场趋势的先见之明为公司挽救了数百万美元。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prescient 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: land that is covered with trees and shrubs

examples.en: The family invested their savings into vast tracts of northern timberland.
examples.zh: 这家人把积蓄投资到了北部广阔的林地中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 timberland 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 嘲笑, 愚弄；表示轻蔑
lemmas.def_en: treat with contemptuous disregard

examples.en: Motorists who flout traffic laws will face heavy fines from the police.
examples.zh: 藐视交通法规的驾驶员将面临警方的巨额罚款。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不愉快的音调, 不协和音, 杂音
lemmas.def_en: a loud harsh or strident noise

examples.en: A cacophony of honking horns echoed through the busy city center at dusk.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，繁忙的市中心回荡着一片刺耳的鸣笛杂音。

lemmas.def_zh: 发音不和谐的, 粗腔横调的
lemmas.def_en: having an unpleasant sound; - John McCarten

examples.en: as cacophonous as a henyard

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cacophony 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a compound formed by an addition reaction

examples.en: The physical therapist asked him to adduct his leg toward the centerline.
examples.zh: 理疗师要求他把腿向身体中心线内收。

lemmas.def_en: a muscle that draws a body part toward the median line
(physiology) moving of a body part toward the central axis of the body
draw a limb towards the body

examples.en: The physical therapist asked him to adduct his leg toward the centerline.
examples.zh: 理疗师要求他把腿向身体中心线内收。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adduct 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several shrubs or small evergreen trees having solitary white or pink or reddish flowers

examples.en: A beautiful pink camellia bloomed quietly in the corner of the garden.
examples.zh: 一朵美丽的山茶花在花园角落里悄然绽放。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 camellia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 类星射电源, 类星体
lemmas.def_en: a starlike object that may send out radio waves and other forms of energy; many have large red shifts

examples.en: Astronomers detected high-energy radiation emanating from a distant and powerful quasar.
examples.zh: 天文学家探测到了来自遥远而强大的类星体的高能辐射。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quasar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of psychology that is concerned with the physiological bases of psychological processes

examples.en: Her groundbreaking research in neuropsychology reveals how brain injuries affect human memory.
examples.zh: 她在神经心理学方面的开创性研究揭示了脑损伤如何影响人类记忆。

lemmas.def_en: of or concerned with neuropsychology

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neuropsychology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 人工推动, 粗暴地对付
lemmas.def_en: handle roughly

examples.en: The security guards manhandled the aggressive protester out of the conference hall.
examples.zh: 保安人员粗暴地将那名好斗的抗议者推出了会议厅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 manhandle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 连本带利的赌, 使增值, 成功地利用
lemmas.def_en: stake winnings from one bet on a subsequent wager

examples.en: She managed to parlay her modest summer internship into a lucrative full-time career.
examples.zh: 她设法成功利用自己不起眼的暑期实习，换来了一份待遇优厚的全职工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parlay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of hair) neat and tidy

examples.en: He always kept his beard neatly trimmed and remarkably kempt for daily meetings.
examples.zh: 为了日常会议，他总是把胡子修剪得整整齐齐，打理得很利落。

lemmas.def_zh: 蓬乱的, 未被照管好的
lemmas.def_en: not neatly combed

examples.en: wild unkempt hair

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kempt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a singer of folk songs

examples.en: The wandering troubadour sang romantic ballads under the open evening sky for tips.
examples.zh: 流浪的吟游诗人在暮色苍茫的夜空下演唱浪漫民谣以赚取赏钱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 troubadour 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: stairway in India leading down to a landing on the water

examples.en: Local pilgrims gathered on the stone ghat early at dawn to bathe peacefully.
examples.zh: 当地朝圣者黎明时分聚集在石阶码头上，平静地沐浴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ghat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person from whom you are descended

examples.en: My forebears sailed across dangerous oceans to seek a better life in America.
examples.zh: 我的祖先们远渡凶险的重洋，去美洲寻找更美好的生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 forebear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (产于非洲刚果河以南的)倭黑猩猩[源自非洲当地语]
lemmas.def_en: small chimpanzee of swamp forests in Zaire; a threatened species

examples.en: Researchers observed how the peaceful bonobo resolves internal social conflicts through grooming.
examples.zh: 研究人员观察了性情温和的倭黑猩猩如何通过理毛来解决内部社交冲突。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bonobo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 装载过多, 负担过多, 使过劳
lemmas.def_en: burden with too much work or responsibility

examples.en: Managers should not overburden young employees with excessive duties during busy holiday seasons.
examples.zh: 在繁忙的假期季节，管理人员不应让年轻员工承担过多的职责。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overburden 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 卷须, 蔓足, 触毛
lemmas.def_en: usually coiled

examples.en: The climbing plant wrapped its delicate cirrus tightly around the wooden garden fence.
examples.zh: 这种攀缘植物用其纤细的卷须紧紧缠绕在花园的木篱笆上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cirrus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: aromatic herb of temperate Eurasia and North Africa having a bitter taste used in making the liqueur absinthe

examples.en: The tired bohemian poet sipped a glass of green absinthe in Paris.
examples.zh: 这位疲倦的波西米亚诗人在巴黎小啜了一杯绿色的苦艾酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 absinthe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or marked by qualities associated with the north wind

examples.en: Vast stretches of dense pine trees thrive naturally throughout the frigid boreal zone.
examples.zh: 大片茂密的松树在寒冷的北方地带自然茁壮生长。

lemmas.def_zh: 北风之神, 北风(拟人化用语)
lemmas.def_en: a wind that blows from the north

examples.en: Chill gusts from Boreas rattled the wooden shutters throughout the winter night.
examples.zh: 整整一个冬夜，呼啸的北风把木百叶窗吹得啪啪作响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 boreal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a final touch; a crowning achievement; a culmination

examples.en: Winning the global championship was the brilliant capstone of her long athletic career.
examples.zh: 赢得全球锦标赛是她漫长体育生涯中最辉煌的顶峰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 capstone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coarse jute fabric

examples.en: Farmers stored freshly harvested golden potatoes in heavy brown burlap sacks for shipment.
examples.zh: 农民们将刚收获的金黄土豆装进厚重的棕色粗麻布袋中以便运送。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burlap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 欧鳊属淡水鱼, 鲷科海鱼
lemmas.def_en: flesh of various freshwater fishes of North America or of Europe

examples.en: The quiet fisherman caught a freshwater bream by the clear river this morning.
examples.zh: 那位安静的渔夫今天早晨在清澈的河边钓到了一条淡水欧鳊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bream 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有盐味的, 令人不快的
lemmas.def_en: distasteful and unpleasant; spoiled by mixture

examples.en: Only tough mangrove trees can survive in the brackish water near the coastline.
examples.zh: 只有顽强的红树林才能在海岸线附近的微咸水中生存。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brackish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 混乱, 喧闹, 疯人院
lemmas.def_en: a state of extreme confusion and disorder

examples.en: The busy trading floor erupted into total bedlam as major stock prices collapsed.
examples.zh: 随着各大股票价格暴跌，繁忙的交易大厅陷入了一片彻底的混乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bedlam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 书目有关的, 书目的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or dealing with bibliography

examples.en: The diligent student verified every bibliographic entry in the academic paper before submission.
examples.zh: 这位勤奋的学生在提交学术论文之前核对了每一条书目条目。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bibliographic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an event that results in a transformation

examples.en: The smooth changeover to the new computer software caused very little office disruption.
examples.zh: 向新计算机软件的平稳转换几乎没有对办公室工作造成任何干扰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 changeover 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 适合的, 一致的, 合谐的, 全等的
lemmas.def_en: corresponding in character or kind

examples.en: His latest public actions are rarely congruent with his loudly proclaimed moral beliefs.
examples.zh: 他最近的公开行为与他高调宣称的道德信念很少保持一致。

lemmas.def_zh: 适合, 一致, 和谐
lemmas.def_en: the quality of agreeing; being suitable and appropriate

examples.en: There was little congruence between his stated goals and his actual actions.
examples.zh: 他声明的目标与实际行动之间几乎没有任何一致性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 congruent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a particular situation that is radically different from the preceding situation

examples.en: We spent a wonderfully warm afternoon watching an exciting ballgame at the stadium.
examples.zh: 我们在体育场度过了一个美妙温暖的下午，看了一场精彩的棒球赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ballgame 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 达尔文主义者, 进化论者
lemmas.def_en: an advocate of Darwinism

examples.en: As a dedicated Darwinian, the professor explained evolution through natural selection principles.
examples.zh: 作为一名坚定的达尔文主义者，这位教授通过自然选择的原理来解释进化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 darwinian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: at an opportune time

examples.en: He made a very insightful comment apropos of the ongoing economic policy discussion.
examples.zh: 他针对当前正在进行的经济政策讨论，发表了非常深刻且恰切的评论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apropos 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an imaginary line on the surface of the earth following (approximately) the 180th meridian

examples.en: The article's dateline showed that it had been sent directly from Tokyo yesterday.
examples.zh: 文章的电头日期显示它是昨天直接从东京发出的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dateline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: remove gas from

examples.en: The chemist used a vacuum pump to degas the liquid mixture completely.
examples.zh: 化学家使用真空泵将液体混合物彻底脱气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 degas 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 每日的, 一日间的, 白天的
lemmas.def_en: of or belonging to or active during the day

examples.en: Hawks are diurnal hunters that rely on bright sunlight to spot their prey.
examples.zh: 鹰是昼行性捕猎者，依靠充足的阳光发现猎物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diurnal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有薄荷香的, 有薄荷味的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or suggestive of mint

examples.en: She always chewed minty gum to keep her breath fresh after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后她总是嚼薄荷味口香糖以保持口气清新。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minty 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a field planted with corn

examples.en: The lost puppy wandered aimlessly through the tall, dense rows of the cornfield.
examples.zh: 走失的小狗在茂密高耸的玉米地行垄间盲目游荡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cornfield 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 又短又秃的(铅笔), 粗而短的(身材), 浓密短硬的(毛发)
lemmas.def_en: short and blunt

examples.en: The old carpenter held the tiny nail securely with his stubby, calloused fingers.
examples.zh: 老木匠用粗短且布满老茧的手指稳稳地捏住小钉子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stubby 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the monovalent group -OH in such compounds as bases and some acids and alcohols

examples.en: The chemical reaction resulted in the formation of a single reactive hydroxyl group.
examples.zh: 该化学反应生成了一个单一的活性羟基。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydroxyl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal backward curve to the vertebral column

examples.en: In the classic novel, the gentle hunchback lived hidden in the cathedral tower.
examples.zh: 在经典小说中，善良的驼背隐居在教堂的钟楼里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hunchback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (used informally) very large

examples.en: The hungry hikers devoured a humongous pizza after finishing their twenty-mile trek.
examples.zh: 饥饿的徒步旅行者完成二十英里跋涉后吃光了一个极大的披萨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 humongous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 顽固的, 刚愎的, 任性的
lemmas.def_en: habitually disposed to disobedience and opposition

examples.en: The headstrong prince refused to listen to any advice offered by his council.
examples.zh: 这位任性的王子拒绝听取顾问团提出的任何建议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headstrong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inn (usually outside city limits on a main road) providing meals and liquor and dancing and (sometimes) gambling

examples.en: Truck drivers often stop at that neon-lit roadhouse for a hearty hot meal.
examples.zh: 卡车司机常在那家亮着霓虹灯的路边小客栈停靠吃顿热乎饭。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roadhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 仿制的矿泉水, 苏打水
lemmas.def_en: naturally effervescent mineral water

examples.en: He poured a glass of chilled seltzer and added a fresh lemon slice.
examples.zh: 他倒了一杯冰镇苏打水，并加了一片新鲜柠檬片。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 seltzer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 向着天空的, 向上的
lemmas.def_en: directed toward heaven or the sky

examples.en: The spectators followed the rocket's skyward ascent until it disappeared into the clouds.
examples.zh: 观众目送火箭向着天空升起，直至它消失在云层中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 skyward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能复归的, 不能削减的, 不可约的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being made smaller or simpler

examples.en: He broke the theory down to its irreducible core concepts for the students.
examples.zh: 他向学生们将该理论拆解为不可缩减的核心概念。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 irreducible 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 肮脏, 贫穷, 不干净
lemmas.def_en: sordid dirtiness

examples.en: The investigative reporter exposed the shocking squalor of the city's abandoned tenements.
examples.zh: 调查记者揭露了该市废弃廉租房令人震惊的脏乱破败。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 squalor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 遁辞, 借口, 托辞
lemmas.def_en: something intended to misrepresent the true nature of an activity

examples.en: The spy relied on clever subterfuge to enter the enemy's fortified military base.
examples.zh: 间谍依靠巧妙的诡计混入了敌人坚固的军事基地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subterfuge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 粗劣作品；迎合低级趣味的作品
lemmas.def_en: excessively garish or sentimental art; usually considered in bad taste

examples.en: Her apartment was crowded with colorful kitsch bought from local souvenir stalls.
examples.zh: 她的公寓里堆满了从当地纪念品摊位买来的廉价俗物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kitsch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: three times as great or many

examples.en: The company reported a threefold increase in profits during the last financial year.
examples.zh: 该公司报告在上一财年实现了利润的三倍增长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 threefold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: food fish of the Indonesian region of the Pacific; resembles gurnards

examples.en: Historians study the traditions of the Flathead tribe across the northern plains.
examples.zh: 历史学家研究了分布在北部平原的扁头印第安部落的传统。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flathead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [动]长尾猴(产于南亚), (H-)[印神] 猴神
lemmas.def_en: in Hinduism, the monkey god and helper of Rama; god of devotion and courage

examples.en: A sacred hanuman leaped across the temple roof, delighting the visiting tourists.
examples.zh: 一只被视为圣兽的长尾猴跃过寺庙屋顶，引得游客格外高兴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hanuman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a swing used by circus acrobats

examples.en: The skilled acrobat performed daring flips on the high trapeze without a net.
examples.zh: 技艺高超的杂技演员在没有防护网的高空吊秋千上完成了大胆的空翻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trapeze 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: within the skull

examples.en: Doctors performed surgery to relieve the intracranial pressure caused by the severe injury.
examples.zh: 医生进行了手术以缓解重伤引起的颅内压。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intracranial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a healthy capacity for vigorous activity

examples.en: The energetic coach was full of vim and ready to inspire the team.
examples.zh: 精力充沛的教练充满活力，随时准备激励球队。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vim 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the hall of a guild or corporation

examples.en: The medieval merchants gathered in the guildhall to discuss regional trade regulations.
examples.zh: 中世纪的商人们聚集在同业工会会所讨论地区贸易法规。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guildhall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 码尺, 计算标准, 准绳
lemmas.def_en: a measure or standard used for comparison

examples.en: Exam results alone cannot serve as the sole yardstick for measuring intelligence.
examples.zh: 单凭考试成绩不能作为衡量智力的唯一准绳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yardstick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (1987年底爆发的)以色列占领区的巴勒斯坦人暴动
lemmas.def_en: an uprising by Palestinian Arabs (in both the Gaza Strip and the West Bank) against Israel in the late 1980s and again in 2000

examples.en: The prolonged intifada disrupted daily life and intensified regional geopolitical tensions significantly.
examples.zh: 长期的起义暴动严重扰乱了日常生活，加剧了地区地缘政治紧张局势。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intifada 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: expletives used informally as intensifiers

examples.en: I spent two hours searching for my goddam keys this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我花了两个小时找我那讨厌的钥匙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goddam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various tropical shrubs widely cultivated for their showy drooping purplish or reddish or white flowers; Central and South America and New Zealand and Tahiti

examples.en: She planted vibrant fuchsia flowers in hanging baskets along the sunny porch.
examples.zh: 她在阳光明媚的门廊边挂篮里种上了鲜艳的倒挂金钟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fuchsia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: habitual relapse into crime

examples.en: The new rehabilitation program aims to reduce rates of criminal recidivism effectively.
examples.zh: 这项新的改造计划旨在有效降低罪犯的累犯率。

lemmas.def_en: someone who is repeatedly arrested for criminal behavior (especially for the same criminal behavior)

examples.en: The judge handed the recidivist a harsher sentence after his latest burglary.
examples.zh: 在最近一次入室盗窃后，法官对这名惯犯判处了更严厉的惩罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 recidivism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood heaped for burning a dead body as a funeral rite

examples.en: Mourners gathered in silence as the funeral pyre was lit at dusk.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分火葬柴堆被点燃，哀悼者们肃立默哀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyre 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the girlfriend of a gangster

examples.en: The notorious gangster was escorted into the club by his stylish moll.
examples.zh: 那个臭名昭著的黑帮分子在时髦情妇的陪伴下步入俱乐部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moll 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a powerful circular current of water (usually the result of conflicting tides)

examples.en: The company was suddenly sucked into a destructive maelstrom of financial scandals.
examples.zh: 该公司突然卷入了一场破坏性的金融丑闻漩涡中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maelstrom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神病院, 极为吵闹的场所
lemmas.def_en: pejorative terms for an insane asylum

examples.en: The stock trading floor quickly turned into a chaotic madhouse during the crash.
examples.zh: 在崩盘期间，股票交易大厅迅速变成了一片混乱的疯人院。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 madhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a railway having a single track

examples.en: A sleek monorail carries tourists seamlessly between the airport and the theme park.
examples.zh: 一辆流线型单轨列车在机场与主题公园之间顺畅地运送游客。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monorail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小旅馆老板, 客栈老板
lemmas.def_en: the owner or manager of an inn

examples.en: The cheerful innkeeper welcomed the weary travelers with warm soup and fresh bread.
examples.zh: 热情的客栈老板用热汤和新鲜面包招待了疲惫的旅客。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 innkeeper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 海滨的, 湖岸的, 沿海的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a coastal or shore region

examples.en: Marine biologists conducted extensive field surveys along the sensitive littoral zone yesterday.
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家昨天沿着脆弱的沿海地带进行了广泛的实地考察。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 littoral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the pancreas; usually marked by abdominal pain

examples.en: Severe abdominal pain prompted the doctor to test the patient for acute pancreatitis.
examples.zh: 剧烈的腹痛促使医生对该患者进行了急性胰腺炎检测。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pancreatitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鲜血, 血, 生机的根源
lemmas.def_en: the blood considered as the seat of vitality

examples.en: Tourism represents the economic lifeblood for many small island nations around the globe.
examples.zh: 旅游业是全球许多小岛屿国家的经济命脉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lifeblood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 魔窟, 地狱, 阎王殿, 无法无天, 一片混乱, 大混乱, 大吵大闹, 乌烟瘴气
lemmas.def_en: a state of extreme confusion and disorder

examples.en: Pandemonium broke out in the stadium when the winning goal was finally scored.
examples.zh: 当制胜球终于踢进时，整个体育场瞬间陷入一片狂欢混乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pandemonium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能让与的, 不能转售的, 不能夺取的, 不可分割的
lemmas.def_en: incapable of being repudiated or transferred to another

examples.en: Freedom of speech is widely recognized as a fundamental and inalienable human right.
examples.zh: 言论自由被广泛认为是一项基本且不可剥夺的人权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inalienable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 风度好的, 讨人喜欢的, 具有行为能力的
lemmas.def_en: (of persons) pleasant in appearance and personality

examples.en: The new sales representative is personable, articulate, and well liked by clients.
examples.zh: 这位新销售代表风度翩翩、口齿伶俐，深受客户喜爱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 personable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small densely furred aquatic monotreme of Australia and Tasmania having a broad bill and tail and webbed feet; only species in the family Ornithorhynchidae

examples.en: The duck-billed platypus is a fascinating semi-aquatic mammal native to eastern Australia.
examples.zh: 鸭嘴兽是一种原产于澳大利亚东部的迷人半水生哺乳动物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 platypus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a polymer of propylene used as a thermoplastic molding material

examples.en: These durable storage containers are manufactured from high-quality recycled polypropylene plastic.
examples.zh: 这些耐用的收纳容器是由优质回收聚丙烯塑料制成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polypropylene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 硫代硫酸钠; 五水合硫代硫酸钠; (俗称)海波
lemmas.def_en: a compound used as a fixing agent in photographic developing

examples.en: The photographer immersed the film into a hypo solution to fix the image.
examples.zh: 摄影师将胶卷浸入大苏打定影液中以固定图像。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a record in which commercial accounts are recorded

examples.en: The angler cast a heavy leger rig deep into the riverbed to catch carp.
examples.zh: 钓鱼者将沉重的底饵钓组抛入河床深处以垂钓鲤鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: artificially high; above the normal voice range

examples.en: The singer switched to a falsetto voice to hit the impossible high notes.
examples.zh: 歌手换用假声唱法来唱出那些极难的高音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 falsetto 为核心的派生词族。
